name: Amarantus
source:
Arik Tereison's made peace with his lot in life: twenty-two and stuck in his parents' house, awaiting his inevitable conscription into a decades-long war.

But after an unexplained attack sends him fleeing home in the middle of the night—told only to hide and wait—he decides he's done with waiting. It's time to change.

You pick yourself up and you keep going, Arik. And maybe you learn from whatever it is you've done. But I will not give up on you before we are finished.

Accompanied by old friends and new strangers, Arik sets off on a journey across the country to confront the tyrannical ruler of the realm.

To make it there, they'll have to navigate a perfect storm of trainwreck decisions, disaster relationships, and backstory.

[From [url=https://amarantus.carrd.co/]official website[/url]]
translation:
阿里克·特雷森 (Arik Tereison) 已经与自己的命运和解了：二十二岁，被困在父母的房子里，等待着不可避免的被征召入伍，参加一场长达数十年的战争。

但在一次不明原因的袭击导致他在半夜逃回家后——只被告知躲起来等待——他决定不再等待。是时候改变了。

你振作起来并继续前进，阿里克。也许你会从你所做的一切中学到东西。但在我们完成之前我不会放弃你。

在老朋友和新陌生人的陪伴下，阿里克踏上了穿越国家的旅程，对抗王国的残暴统治者。

为了到达那里，他们必须应对一场由灾难决策、灾难关系和背景故事组成的完美风暴。

[来自[url=https://amarantus.carrd.co/]官网[/url]]
